name: open
notes: No files and no index of its own: carttrace.sandbox.catalogs.pools draws each category's pool from the members' indexes, at most 5,000 products a member, into var/catalogs/open-pools/.

A pooled store mixes every member's products in one US store in synthetic dollars: a Lazada product's price is drawn from the same per-category band as ABO's and WANDS', its own peso price kept in provenance.derived.source_price (sandbox.open_pool_markets mixed, the default); home puts Lazada's products only in PH stores, priced in pesos.
title: The open product pools: every publishable catalog, per category
